earth.name: Sunny Meadow
earth.subtitle: Home world

bloom.title: A Green Thread
bloom.text: Colour creeps back into the grass. Dr. Zonk says the soil remembers you.

bloom.title: The Meadow Stirs
bloom.text: Seeds you never planted push up overnight. The Vault is answering.

bloom.title: Full Bloom
bloom.text: The meadow is awake. One world down — and the sky is full of dark ones.

earth.intro: Everything grew from here once. Then the Bloom went quiet and the world forgot how. You still remember. Start small: a twig, a pebble, a berry.

projects.name: Clear the Path
talk: Oh! A visitor! Nobody has come up the old path in years.
Ever since the Bloom faded, the meadow just... stopped. Brambles everywhere.
Tap the Big Tree for twigs, put two together and you get a branch. Two branches and we can clear the path!
projects.text: You can see the road to the village again! And look what was under the brambles — an old rock pile. It is yours now.

projects.name: A Stone Border
talk: Nana Luma's garden used to be the prettiest in the valley.
Used to be, dear. Now the weeds walk right in. A stone border would keep them out.
Two rocks and a log. We can do that!
projects.text: A tidy border round the garden. Nana Luma peeked over it and spotted a berry bush that is ready to fruit again.

projects.name: Nana Luma's Jam
talk: Berries! Real berries! My hands remember the recipe even if my head does not.
One jar of jam and two bunches for the pie tin, and we shall have a proper tea.
The pie tin is hereby confiscated. Mayoral privilege.
projects.text: The first jar of jam in years! Chef Gubbo was so moved he put up a windmill on the hill — flour for everyone. And a rain cloud is drifting over: catch the drops while it is here.

projects.name: Mend the Old Well
talk: That cloud reminded me — the village well dried up the year the Bloom went.
If we fill it once, maybe it remembers how to fill itself?
Bring water while the cloud is here, dear. Puddles merge into a jug.
projects.text: The well is singing again, so water is here to stay. ...Wait. What is that in the sky?

projects.name: Dr. Zonk's Workshop
talk: Blorp. Thank you for not screaming. Most planets scream.
I need a little workshop to fix it. Some star scrap, some lumber, one shiny geode for the lens.
A real star-traveller! From a DIFFERENT planet! Can I help? CAN I?
projects.text: Dr. Zonk's Lab hums to life. Bring it things you do not need and it turns them into 🧪 Science — Science buys upgrades that last for ever.

projects.name: Mend the Fences
talk: Citizens! As your Mayor I declare the fence... broken. Also my hat was eaten.
The goats keep eating hats. Nana Luma's, the Mayor's, mine...
My second-best hat. Two lumber piles and a pie for the carpenter, please.
projects.text: Mayor Marin cuts a ribbon on the new fence (twice — the first take was bad), and the hay meadow behind it is growing tall again.

projects.name: Harvest Supper
talk: The whole village used to eat together at harvest. Long tables, lanterns, too much cake.
Let's do it again! A hay bale for seats, a cake, and a barrel of water.
What is cake. I would like to learn about cake.
projects.text: Everyone came. Dr. Zonk had three slices. Sirra arrived late with a packet of flower seeds, "for a little colour, darling".

projects.name: The Flower Market
talk: Darling, a village without a flower market is just a lot of houses.
A bouquet for the stall, and a gemstone for the sign. People notice a gemstone.
projects.text: Colour on every stall! A tea bush sprouted by the market, and the flowers brought the bees back — a wild hive has settled for a while. Catch its honey.

projects.name: Honey Cakes
talk: Honey cake! The recipe calls for real honeycomb, not the sad syrup kind.
And a cake to put it on, I suppose. Quickly, before the bees move on.
projects.text: Honey cakes for everyone. Nana Luma says the old mossy log in the woods is sprouting mushrooms again — she knows a recipe.

projects.name: Forest Tea
talk: My mother made forest tea every spring. Mushrooms and well water, nothing more.
Bring me a ring of caps, and a fountain for the square while you are at it. We had one once.
On my world, tea is a colour. Here it is a drink. Fascinating.
projects.text: The fountain splashes in the square. Behind it, the old cotton patch is fluffing up white.

projects.name: Patchwork Coats
talk: Autumn is coming and everyone is dressed like a scarecrow. No offence to the scarecrow.
A bolt of cloth and a straw hat. I will do the rest. I always do the rest.
projects.text: Warm coats for the whole village. The birds have come back to nest in Ember's old bird box.

projects.name: Bird Song
talk: The songbirds are back but they need somewhere cosy. A nest! And a garland so it looks nice!
Birds do not care about garlands, Ember.
projects.text: The birds sang all evening, and someone left a painted toy chest by the barn. Then Ember came running: something small crashed behind the hill — and it is blinking!

projects.name: The Little Visitors
talk: Blorp! Those are Blinkies. Babies. They hatch from the eggs in that wreck.
Can we keep one?! Can we?
Help one grow up, and keep a speckled egg warm for the next. They are far from home. Like me.
projects.text: The little visitors are safe and very hungry. Zib dug a veggie patch so nobody goes to bed without supper.

projects.name: A Garden for Guests
talk: The crows are a threat to civic order. I have drafted a strongly worded letter.
Or... two carrots for the Blinkies and a scarecrow for the crows?
projects.text: The garden thrives. Dr. Zonk dragged an old tinker bench out of the barn: "for lenses. We need to see where we are going."

projects.name: Stargazing Night
talk: Dr. Zonk says his home is up THERE. Somewhere. Behind the Moon.
A spyglass to find the way. A statue to mark this spot, so we can always come back.
And a basket of veggies, because nobody stargazes on an empty stomach.
projects.text: Through the spyglass: the Moon, and on it, tiny lights. "Crater Camp," whispers Dr. Zonk. "Friends." Back on the ground, the old hollow behind the barn has filled with water — a lily pond!

projects.name: The Village Bakery
talk: Hello hello! Chef Gubbo, baker. Well — baker without a bakery.
Bring me carrots, hay for the oven floor and a bundle of veggies, and I will build us a proper bakery.
A bakery! Warm buns every morning!
projects.text: The bakery is open. Chef Gubbo hands you the first warm bun — and a chest of thanks.

projects.name: Pottery Day
talk: Bread on the table but no bowls to put it in. Uncivilised, darling.
A loaf for the potters, a nest and a quilt to pack the kiln. There is clay by the river.
projects.text: The old clay pit by the river is open again. Sirra has already ordered twelve vases.

projects.name: Tea in the Garden
talk: Duchess Splatt, delighted. I have come a very long way for a proper cup of tea.
Pots for the seedlings, rolls for the guests and flowers for the table, if you would be so kind.
projects.text: Tea is served under the parasol. Duchess Splatt declares the meadow "almost civilised".

projects.name: The Lily Pond
talk: The pond needs a garden! A fountain, an urn and Nana Luma's teapot!
For the frogs. Frogs with THREE EYES deserve nice things.
projects.text: Fountain, urn and teapot by the pond: the three-eyed frogs are holding a tea party.

projects.name: Toys for the Blinkies
talk: The little Blinkies are bored. Bored Blinkies chew rockets.
They chewed my sash. My OFFICIAL sash.
The Mayor agrees. More toys, please, before they find the fuel tank.
projects.text: The Blinkies are busy with new toys. Nothing has been chewed for an entire hour.

projects.name: The Toy Parade
talk: Everyone is here: Chef Gubbo, Duchess Splatt, the Blinkies... let us have a parade before the launch!
A toy robot to lead it, koi for the pond float, and a bun tower for after.
projects.text: The best parade the meadow has ever seen. Then everyone turns to look at the rocket.

projects.name: The Launch Pad
talk: The rocket is nearly ready. It needs a pad that will not crack, and water to cool the engines.
A cart for the fuel, a telescope for the pilot, and an aqueduct for the water. We will miss you, Dr. Zonk.
Miss? No. You are coming too.
projects.text: The pad holds, the rocket stands, the meadow is awake. Sunny Meadow is restored — and Luna is waiting.

luna.name: Crater Camp
luna.subtitle: Luna

bloom.title: Dust Remembers
bloom.text: Glow spores drift up out of the regolith. Nothing has grown here in an age.

bloom.title: The Craters Sing
bloom.text: Light pools in the low places. Luma says it sounds like a choir tuning up.

bloom.title: Luna Awake
bloom.text: The grey moon is silver now, and gardens ring every crater rim.

luna.intro: Luna went cold first — no air, no argument. But the Vault says a world only needs one living thing to start over. Find it.

projects.name: Light the Camp
talk: Oh, far out. Visitors. Sorry it is so dark, man — the lamps gave up years ago.
Two moon shards and a glow bulb and I can make a little ring of light. Vibes first, then everything else.
Zib stowed away in the cargo hold. Zib regrets nothing. Zib is cold.
projects.text: A little ring of glow around the tents. The dark is smaller already.

projects.name: Build a Dust Wall
talk: GREETINGS. I AM ROKK. I WAS THE BUTLER OF THIS CAMP. THE CAMP LEFT. I STAYED.
THE DUST STORMS KNOCK OVER THE TENTS. TWO REGOLITH BRICKS AND ONE ICE SHARD FOR MORTAR. PLEASE.
Zib could sell him a wall. Zib will not. Zib is being nice. Note it.
projects.text: WALL: STANDING. WIND: BLOCKED. ROKK: PROUD.

projects.name: The Crystal Garden
talk: Ah. Tourists. Mind the crystals, they are older than your planet and twice as interesting.
A prism core and a glow flower. I am building a garden. A tasteful one. You would not understand.
projects.text: Nix has arranged the crystals by colour, then by size, then by mood.

projects.name: Lanterns for the Dark Side
talk: THE FAR SIDE IS DARK FOR FOURTEEN DAYS AT A TIME. I DO NOT LIKE IT. I AM NOT AFRAID. I AM A ROBOT.
A MOON LANTERN AND A SILVER INGOT FOR THE HANDLE. FOR NO REASON. NOT FEAR.
projects.text: Rokk walks the far side at night now. Humming. Rokk does not hum. Rokk is humming.

projects.name: Catch a Comet
talk: A comet passes every night at nine, man. Like clockwork. Like a really cold friend.
Catch me its core and a ball of clear ice. Comets carry seeds, you know. Old ones.
Blorp. She is right. I checked. I hate it when the hippie is right.
projects.text: The comet's ice was full of old seeds. Nana Luma planted every one.

projects.name: Moon Launch Pad
talk: Zib has a business proposal. A launch pad. Zib builds, you pay, everybody flies.
Moon brick, moon star, one beacon so the pilot does not miss. Zib missed once. Long story.
There is a fire planet in range. Ember Hollow. Bring a towel. And a fire extinguisher.
projects.text: Beep! Pad ready! Zib tested it. Zib only exploded a little. Ember Hollow is in range now!

projects.name: A Home for the Pups
talk: Those bouncing things are moon pups. They chew crystals. MY crystals.
Give them a burrow somewhere far from my garden. A pup and a moth to keep them company.
projects.text: The pups have a burrow with a view. They bounce off the walls. Literally.

projects.name: The Rover Garage
talk: Zib found an old rover. Zib needs a garage. And a silver cup. For the grand opening.
THERE WILL BE NO GRAND OPENING.
There will be a SMALL grand opening.
projects.text: Six wheels, one drill, zero brakes. Zib loves it.

projects.name: Fuel the Heaters
talk: THE HEATERS RUN ON HELIUM. THE HELIUM RUNS OUT. EVERYONE IS COLD. MOSTLY ME. I AM METAL.
ONE GAS CANISTER AND ONE GLACIER BLOCK FOR THE COOLANT. THE IRONY IS NOT LOST ON ME.
projects.text: WARM. The whole crew slept through the night for the first time.

projects.name: Call Home
talk: The old dish still points at the sky. If it turns again, the camp can talk to everyone out there.
A radar dish, a pallasite for the tuner, and a glow tree for the vibes. Mostly the vibes.
Fine. I will admit it. I would like to call someone.
projects.text: The dish turns, the stars answer. Crater Camp is part of the sky again.

cindra.name: Ember Hollow
cindra.subtitle: Cindra

bloom.title: Ash to Soil
bloom.text: Where the ash cooled, something soft is growing through it.

bloom.title: The Hollow Breathes
bloom.text: The vents sigh instead of roaring. Vulk has not seen that in his lifetime.

bloom.title: Cindra Reborn
bloom.text: Fire and garden, at the same time, without either winning. That is the whole trick.

cindra.intro: Cindra never went dormant — it went furious. The Bloom here did not die of cold. It burned. Ash is still soil, if you are patient.

projects.name: Rekindle the Forge
talk: HRM. A visitor. The forge has been cold for a hundred years. I have been angry for a hundred and one.
Two cinders and an ash mushroom. The forge eats, then it works. Like me.
projects.text: The forge breathes. Vulk pretends it was nothing. It was not nothing.

projects.name: New Tools
talk: The forge breathes. Now it needs tools. My old ones melted. My mood melted them.
An iron ingot and two obsidian shards. Sharp things. Good things.
projects.text: Hammers, tongs and one very large spoon. Vulk will not explain the spoon.

projects.name: The Glass Stall
talk: A REAL VISITOR! Do you want a glass bead? I make glass beads! I make TOO MANY glass beads!
Two beads and a big mushroom for the stall roof. Travellers will come. They will! Probably!
projects.text: Ember sells beads to travellers who have not arrived yet. She says they will.

projects.name: Stew for Everyone
talk: Everyone here is grumpy because nobody has eaten. Vulk has not eaten since the volcano.
I had a rock in spring.
A jar of spice and a forge fire. STEW. The spiciest stew in the system.
projects.text: Very, very spicy. Nobody complained. Nobody could speak.

projects.name: The Bell Tower
talk: The vents roar at night. The old bell used to calm them. Do not ask how. I do not know.
A copper bell and a fire opal for the clapper. Then we sleep.
projects.text: The bell rings at sunset. The vents seem to quieten when it does.

projects.name: Heat-Proof Launch Pad
talk: A launch pad on a planet made of fire. Blorp. What could go wrong.
Iron anvil for the base. Obsidian mirror to throw the heat back. Bellows to cool the engines.
And a little flag! I will make the flag!
projects.text: It will not melt. Probably. Blorp. Tidal Shallows is next — pack a towel.

projects.name: Nests for the Salamanders
talk: The salamanders keep sleeping in Vulk's boots.
One salamander and an ember egg — they need a nest of their own!
projects.text: Tiny flames curled in warm stone. They follow Ember everywhere now.

projects.name: The Basalt Hall
talk: Too many people now. Meetings. Opinions. I need a hall with thick walls.
A column stack and a copper cog for the door. A door that closes.
projects.text: A hall of stone columns, cool inside, warm outside. Meetings happen there now.

projects.name: Steam Power
talk: GREETINGS AGAIN. I FOLLOWED THE STEAM. STEAM IS POWER. POWER IS ORDER.
ONE BOILER AND TWO SULFUR CRYSTALS. THE SMELL IS UNFORTUNATE. THE PROGRESS IS NOT.
projects.text: PRESSURE: NOMINAL. HOLLOW: POWERED. ROKK: ALSO NOMINAL.

projects.name: The Ember Orchard
talk: Last one! A garden that grows in fire! Fruit that is warm when you pick it!
A fruit basket, the great forge and a ruby shard to mark the spot. Then Cindra is ours again.
And then the oceans, friend. Tidal Shallows. You will need that towel after all.
projects.text: Fire and garden at the same time, without either winning. Cindra is reborn.

nerith.name: Tidal Shallows
nerith.subtitle: Nerith

bloom.title: The Water Clears
bloom.text: Silt settles. For the first time in centuries you can see the reef floor.

bloom.title: Reefs Return
bloom.text: Coral climbing the old ruins, fish following it up. Sirra will not stop humming.

bloom.title: Nerith Alive
bloom.text: A whole drowned world, breathing again through its gills.

nerith.intro: Nerith drowned slowly and politely. The cities are still down there under the shallows, full of shells and nothing else. Wake the reef and the rest follows.

projects.name: Clean the Beach
projects.text: Sand you can actually walk on. Kelpa made a sandcastle. Then another. Then eleven.

projects.name: Replant the Reef
projects.text: Little corals in neat rows. The first fish arrived an hour later.

projects.name: The Fish Market
projects.text: The market smells of salt and gossip. Exactly right.

projects.name: Salt the Catch
projects.text: Enough stores for the whole winter. Marin counted twice.

projects.name: Raise the Wreck
projects.text: The old skiff floats again. Sirra swears it is the same boat her grandmother sailed.

projects.name: The Floating Launch Pad
projects.text: It bobs a bit. The rocket does not mind. Aurora Reach — the last world — is in range.

projects.name: Guard the Hatchlings
projects.text: Every hatchling made it to the water. Kelpa counted every single one, out loud.

projects.name: The Harbour
projects.text: Boats come and go. Some of them from worlds you woke.

projects.name: Sea-Glass Lamps
projects.text: The shallows glow green at night. The humming is louder now.

projects.name: Wake the Drowned City
projects.text: The domes break the surface, glittering. Nerith breathes again.

vela.name: Aurora Reach
vela.subtitle: Vela

bloom.title: First Light
bloom.text: A thread of aurora, thin as a hair, stitched across the dark.

bloom.title: The Sky Weaves
bloom.text: Whole curtains of it now. Halo says the Vault is singing back.

bloom.title: The Bloom Returns
bloom.text: Every world you woke is visible from here, lit up like lamps in a long hallway. You did that.

vela.intro: The last place the Bloom was seen alive. There is no ground here — only cloud, light and whatever you can grow on them. This is where it ends, or begins again.

projects.name: Solid Ground
projects.text: A cloud you can stand on. Zephyr has been jumping on it for an hour.

projects.name: Stitch the Sky
projects.text: One stripe of colour across the dark. Halo keeps looking up.

projects.name: The Sky Orchard
projects.text: Golden fruit on floating branches. The birds found it before anyone.

projects.name: Tune the Chimes
projects.text: The chimes play a tune nobody taught them. Halo says it is the Vault singing back.

projects.name: Nests on the Wind
projects.text: Nests on every cloud. The sky birds are home.

projects.name: The Drift Yards
projects.text: Balloons between the islands. Everyone can visit everyone now.

projects.name: A Den for the Star-Kits
projects.text: The little star-kits have a den of their own. They glow brighter when you visit.

projects.name: The Orbital Station
projects.text: Every camp on every world can talk to every other. Zib has not stopped beeping.

projects.name: The Celestial Garden
projects.text: Flowers that glow, planets that spin, a garden in the sky.

projects.name: The Bloom Returns
projects.text: Five worlds, all lit. The Vault is empty and the galaxy is full. That was the whole idea.
